provenance.quote: Shall the Township of Old Bridge impose an annual tax levy of up to $.03 Per $100.00 of assessed real property value and the amounts raised by such levy shall be deposited into the “Old Bridge Township Open Space Recreation and Farmland Preservation Trust Fund” and used exclusively for the following purposes: 1. The acquisition of lands for recreation and conservation purposes; 2. The acquisition of farmland for farmland preservation purposes; 3. The development of lands acquired for recreation and conservation purposes; 4. The maintenance of lands acquired for recreation and conservation purposes; 5. The historic preservation of historic properties, structures, facilities, sites, areas or objects, and the acquisition of such properties, facilities, sites, areas, or objects for Historic preservation purposes; and 6. The payment of debt service or indebtedness issued or incurred by the municipality for any of the purposes set forth in (1), (2), (4), and (5), above. The amount or rate of the annual levy to be allocated to each of the purposes set forth above shall be determined at a later date by the Township Council, upon approval of the proposition by the voters, after conducting at least one public hearing thereon. Any and all interest or other income earned on monies in the fund shall be credited to the fund to be used for the above-described purposes.

measures.officialStatement: The passage of this proposition would permit the Township of Old Bridge to impose an “Open Space Tax” for purposes of funding the “Old Bridge Township Open Space Recreation and Farmland and Historic Preservation Trust Fund." This fund can be used for acquiring and/or preserving farmland, open space, recreational and historic land, easements, development rights, or other interests in such real property. The revenue can also be used to acquire, improve, maintain, and/or preserve open space, recreational and historic properties for future generations to enjoy, as well as either purchase or deed restrict property so that remains as preserved open space and/or farmland. The revenue may also be used to pay the debt service on indebtedness issued or incurred for acquisition and/or preservation of open space, recreational and historical properties, open space preservation, farmland preservation, and historic preservation of historic properties. The Township would annually levy a tax rate of up to three (3) cents per $100.00 of total Township assessed real property value. The amount or rate of the annual levy to be allocated among the six purposes set forth above shall be determined by the Township Council after conducting one public hearing. As an example, at the rate of three (3) cents per $100 of assessed value, the owner of a property assessed at $125,000.00 would pay an additional $37.50 per year in real property taxes.

measures.questionText: Should the Borough of Sayreville amend its Length of Service Award Program (LOSAP) to increase the annual base contribution for each qualifying active volunteer member of a qualified emergency service organization of the Borough of Sayreville from Seven Hundred Fifty and 00/100 ($750.00) Dollars to One Thousand, One Hundred Fifty and 00/100 ($1,150.00) Dollars, with an automatic annual cost of living adjustments based upon the Consumer Price Index as annually determined by the Director of the Division of Local Government Services as permitted by law?
measures.officialStatement: In 1999, the Borough of Sayreville established a Length of Services Awards Program (“LOSAP") pursuant to N.J.S.A. 40A:14- 183, et seq., which was adopted in Ordinance No. 624-99, and approved by public referendum at the November 2, 1999 general election. The LOSAP originally set the annual contribution for qualified, active volunteers to be Seven Hundred Fifty and 00/100 ($750.00) Dollars. The Borough’s LOSAP contributions have not been increased since it was originally established in 1999. The Mayor and Borough Council now seek the approval of the legal voters of the Borough of Sayreville, Middlesex County, New Jersey, to increase the Borough’s existing annual LOSAP contributions to One Thousand, One Hundred Fifty and 00/100 ($1,150.00) Dollars, with an automatic annual cost of living adjustments based upon the Consumer Price Index as annually determined by the Director of the Division of Local Government Services. All other terms and requirements of the LOSAP will remain the same. The Borough’s LOSAP currently applies to qualified, active volunteer members of the Sayreville Volunteer Fire Department, the Sayreville Emergency Squad, and the Morgan First Aid Squad. A YES vote on this Referendum would authorize the Mayor and Borough Council to increase the annual contribution under its existing LOSAP to $1,150 per qualifying active volunteer member of a qualified services organization of the Borough of Sayreville. A NO vote on this Referendum would not allow the Mayor and Borough Council to increase its annual LOSAP contribution, which would remain at $750 per qualifying active volunteer member of a qualified services organization of the Borough of Sayreville.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes Old Bridge to levy an annual property tax of up to 3 cents per $100 of assessed value for its open-space, recreation, farmland and historic-preservation trust fund. The money could acquire recreation and conservation land or farmland; develop and maintain recreation and conservation land; and preserve and acquire historic properties, structures, facilities, sites, areas or objects. The ballot’s debt provision covers land and farmland acquisition, maintenance of recreation and conservation land, and historic preservation and acquisition. After at least one public hearing, the Township Council would determine how much of the levy to allocate to each permitted purpose. Interest and other income earned on the fund would stay in it for the same purposes. At the full 3-cent rate, the ballot’s example is an additional $37.50 a year for property assessed at $125,000.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the proposed annual tax of up to 3 cents per $100, with the listed uses and public-hearing requirement.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed open-space tax and its funding authorization.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Raises Sayreville’s annual contribution to its Length of Service Award Program from $750 to $1,150 for each qualifying active volunteer emergency-service member. It adds automatic annual cost-of-living adjustments based on the Consumer Price Index, as determined by the state Division of Local Government Services director and permitted by law. The program currently covers qualified active volunteers in the Sayreville Volunteer Fire Department, Sayreville Emergency Squad and Morgan First Aid Squad; other terms and eligibility requirements would stay the same.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the increase to $1,150 per qualifying active volunteer member, with the automatic annual cost-of-living adjustments.
measureRecords.noMeans: Keep the annual contribution at $750 per qualifying active volunteer member and reject this proposed increase.
